image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered Scaphognathus jaw asset, featuring an isolated jaw structure composed strictly of upper and lower horizontal bars, completely omitting the back skull, temporal fenestrae, and eye sockets for optimal UI legibility.

assets.name: Isolated Jaw-Only Composition
assets.description: A tight, dedicated asset composition featuring strictly the open upper and lower jaw bars viewed in clean left profile, entirely omitting the back portion of the skull, post-orbital structures, and eye sockets.

assets.name: Right-Side Up Orientation
assets.description: Correctly oriented right-side up, with the upper jaw positioned stably above the lower jaw on a neutral 50% grey studio floor plane with soft contact shadows.

assets.name: Strict Left Profile Perspective
assets.description: Viewed from a direct, flat left profile camera angle with the open mouth facing right, eliminating three-quarter rotation to prevent unintended cranial generation.

assets.name: Long and Boxy Snout Beams
assets.description: An elongated, sharply squared-off horizontal upper beam and matching lower jaw bar that define the non-human geometric form of the Scaphognathus tooth-cage structure.

assets.name: Stubby Peg Teeth with Wide Spacing
assets.description: Short, blunt, rounded-tip ivory peg teeth lined strictly along the outer margins of the jaw bars, separated by wide, distinct open gaps to form the signature tooth-cage silhouette.

assets.name: Terracotta Vinyl Finish
assets.description: Warm terracotta-colored matte vinyl-like texture with soft, stylized edges consistent with the animated feature film aesthetic, preserving a strict 25% negative space safety margin.
